57: /** A collector/namespace/export service, never an alternative application state or executor. */
58: export function createResearchService(deps: ResearchServiceDeps) {
59:   const documents = createLocalDocumentReader({
60:     resolveFile: (id) => deps.files.resolvePath(id),
61:     xlsxWorkerPath: deps.xlsxWorkerPath,
62:   });
63:   const adapters = createResearchAdapters();
64:   const reports = new Map<ResearchProviderId, ConnectionReport>();
65:   const versions = new Map<ResearchProviderId, number>();
66:   const tests = new Map<ResearchProviderId, Promise<ResearchProviderStatus>>();
67:   const caches = new Map<string, Map<string, Promise<CollectedItem[]>>>();
68:   const cacheBytes = new Map<string, number>();
69:   const pending = new Map<string, Set<Promise<unknown>>>();
70:   const safeValues = new Map<string, Set<string>>();
71:   const active = new Set<AbortController>();
72:   let accessEpoch = 0;
73:   function revokeActive() {
74:     accessEpoch++;
75:     for (const controller of active)
76:       controller.abort(new DOMException("Research access changed; start a new run.", "AbortError"));
77:   }
78:   const actor = () => ({ type: "human" as const, ...deps.settings().review.reviewer });
79:   const credentials = async () =>
80:     Object.fromEntries(
81:       await Promise.all(
82:         SECRET_NAMES.map(
83:           async (name) => [name, (await deps.secrets.getSecret(name)) ?? undefined] as const,
84:         ),
85:       ),
86:     );
87:   async function status(id: ResearchProviderId): Promise<ResearchProviderStatus> {
88:     const secrets = await deps.secrets.getStatus();
89:     const flags = Object.fromEntries(
90:       PROVIDER_SECRETS[id].map((name) => [name, secrets[name].configured]),
91:     );
92:     const missing = id !== "openalex" && PROVIDER_SECRETS[id].some((name) => !flags[name]);
93:     return {
94:       id,
95:       config: structuredClone(deps.settings().research.apis[id]),
96:       credentialsConfigured: flags,
97:       connection: reports.get(id) ?? {
98:         state: missing ? "not_configured" : "untested",
99:         message: missing
100:           ? "Required credentials are missing."
101:           : "Configured but not tested. No provider request has been made.",
102:         capabilities: [],
103:         limitations: [],
104:       },
105:     };
106:   }
107:   function invalidate(id: ResearchProviderId) {
108:     versions.set(id, (versions.get(id) ?? 0) + 1);
109:     reports.delete(id);
110:     revokeActive();
111:   }
112:   function collector(runId: string, blockId: string, settings: Settings): ResearchCollector {
113:     RunId.parse(runId);
114:     BlockId.parse(blockId);
115:     return {
116:       collect(request, context) {
117:         assertJsonByteBudget(request, 1024 * 1024);
118:         if (context.runId !== runId)
119:           throw new ReqflowError("invalid_input", "Research collector run does not match context.");
120:         let tasks = pending.get(runId);
121:         if (!tasks) pending.set(runId, (tasks = new Set()));
122:         // Reserve before asynchronous credential loading so policy changes cannot
123:         // slip between startup and transport creation.
124:         const controller = new AbortController();
125:         const epoch = accessEpoch;
126:         active.add(controller);
127:         const signal = AbortSignal.any([context.signal, controller.signal]);
128:         const work = (async () => {
129:           try {
130:             signal.throwIfAborted();
131:             const keys = await credentials();
132:             if (epoch !== accessEpoch)
133:               controller.abort(new DOMException("Research access changed.", "AbortError"));
134:             signal.throwIfAborted();
135:             let values = safeValues.get(runId);
136:             if (!values) safeValues.set(runId, (values = new Set()));
137:             for (const key of Object.values(keys)) if (key) values.add(key);
138:             let cache = caches.get(runId);
139:             if (!cache) caches.set(runId, (cache = new Map()));
140:             const cachedDocuments = {
141:               ...documents,
142:               read(id: string, maxPages: number, signal: AbortSignal) {
143:                 const key = `${id}:${maxPages}`;
144:                 let result = cache!.get(key);
145:                 if (!result) {
146:                   if (cache!.size >= 1000)
147:                     throw new ProviderError(
148:                       "limit_reached",
149:                       "Per-run document cache exceeds 1000 reads.",
150:                     );
151:                   result = documents.read(id, maxPages, signal).then((items) => {
152:                     const bytes = jsonByteSize(items, PERSISTED_JSON_MAX_BYTES);
153:                     if (bytes > PERSISTED_JSON_MAX_BYTES - (cacheBytes.get(runId) ?? 0))
154:                       throw new ProviderError(
155:                         "limit_reached",
156:                         "Per-run document cache exceeds 64 MiB raw-data budget.",
157:                       );
158:                     cacheBytes.set(runId, (cacheBytes.get(runId) ?? 0) + bytes);
159:                     return items;
160:                   });
161:                   cache!.set(key, result);
162:                   void result.catch(() => cache!.delete(key));
163:                 }
164:                 return result;
165:               },
166:             };
167:             // The current access configuration is authoritative. A persisted/stale run cannot
168:             // undo a provider revocation or widen global domain policy.
169:             const live = deps.settings().research;
170:             const snapshot = Settings.parse({
171:               ...settings,
172:               research: {
173:                 ...settings.research,
174:                 // Off is an immediate kill switch, not a new provider selection for old runs.
175:                 provider: live.provider === "off" ? "off" : settings.research.provider,
176:                 apis: live.apis,
177:                 allowedDomains: live.allowedDomains,
178:                 blockedDomains: live.blockedDomains,
179:               },
180:             });
181:             return await createResearchCollector({
182:               settings: snapshot,
183:               credentials: keys,
184:               documents: cachedDocuments,
185:               fetchImpl: deps.fetchImpl,
186:               async save(dataset) {
187:                 const parts = deps.datasets.blocks(runId);
188:                 // Migrated aggregate-only originals must survive the first new block save.
189:                 if (!parts.size) {
190:                   const previous = deps.datasets.get(runId);
191:                   if (previous) parts.set("legacy", previous);
192:                 }
193:                 parts.set(blockId, dataset);
194:                 const aggregate = mergeResearchDatasets(...parts.values());
195:                 assertJsonByteBudget(dataset, RESEARCH_DATASET_MAX_BYTES);
196:                 assertJsonByteBudget(aggregate, RESEARCH_DATASET_MAX_BYTES);
197:                 deps.datasets.save(runId, blockId, dataset, aggregate);
198:               },
199:             }).collect(request, { ...context, signal });
200:           } finally {
201:             active.delete(controller);
202:           }
203:         })();
204:         tasks.add(work);
205:         void work.then(
206:           () => tasks!.delete(work),
207:           () => tasks!.delete(work),
208:         );
209:         return work;
210:       },
211:     };
212:   }
213:   const handlers: ReqflowHandlers["research"] = {
214:     agents: async () => structuredClone(RESEARCH_AGENTS),
215:     providers: async () => Promise.all(ResearchProviderId.options.map(status)),
216:     configure: async (input, value) => {
217:       const id = ResearchProviderId.parse(input),
218:         config = ResearchProviderConfig.parse(value);
219:       const settings = structuredClone(deps.settings());
220:       settings.research.apis[id] = config;
221:       deps.saveSettings(settings);
222:       invalidate(id);
223:       await deps.audit.record({
224:         actor: actor(),
225:         action: "settings.changed",
226:         entityType: "settings",
227:         entityId: `provider:${id}`,
228:         rationale: "Provider access configuration saved. No credential values.",
229:       });
230:       return status(id);
231:     },
232:     test: async (input) => {
233:       const id = ResearchProviderId.parse(input);
234:       const previous = tests.get(id);
235:       if (previous) return previous;
236:       const generation = versions.get(id) ?? 0;
237:       const config = structuredClone(deps.settings().research.apis[id]);
238:       const work = (async () => {
239:         const current = await status(id);
240:         if (
241:           id !== "openalex" &&
242:           PROVIDER_SECRETS[id].some((name) => !current.credentialsConfigured[name])
243:         )
244:           return current;
245:         // Explicit user-triggered authentication tests do not run actors or grant data access.
246:         const keys = await credentials();
247:         const signal = AbortSignal.timeout(15000);
248:         const limits = ResearchLimits.parse({
249:           maxRequests: 3,
250:           maxResults: 1,
251:           maxDocumentPages: 1,
252:           timeoutMs: 15000,
253:           retries: 0,
254:           concurrency: 1,
255:         });
256:         let report: ConnectionReport;
257:         try {
258:           report = ConnectionReport.parse(
259:             await adapters.get(id)!.test({
260:               http: createProviderHttp({ limits, signal, fetchImpl: deps.fetchImpl }),
261:               credentials: keys,
262:               config,
263:               limits,
264:               signal,
265:               log() {},
266:               now: () => new Date().toISOString(),
267:               documents,
268:             }),
269:           );
270:         } catch (error) {
271:           report = {
272:             state:
273:               error instanceof ProviderError &&
274:               [
275:                 "invalid_credentials",
276:                 "permission_required",
277:                 "rate_limited",
278:                 "unsupported",
279:               ].includes(error.code)
280:                 ? (error.code as "invalid_credentials")
281:                 : "unreachable",
282:             message: "Provider test failed. No sensitive response details retained.",
283:             testedAt: new Date().toISOString(),
284:             capabilities: [],
285:             limitations: [],
286:           };
287:         }
288:         const values = Object.values(keys).filter((key): key is string => !!key);
289:         report.message = redactSecrets(report.message, values).slice(0, 2048);
290:         report.capabilities = report.capabilities
291:           .slice(0, 50)
292:           .map((text) => redactSecrets(text, values).slice(0, 512));
293:         report.limitations = report.limitations
294:           .slice(0, 50)
295:           .map((text) => redactSecrets(text, values).slice(0, 512));
296:         if ((versions.get(id) ?? 0) === generation) reports.set(id, report);
297:         return status(id);
298:       })();
299:       tests.set(id, work);
300:       try {
301:         return await work;
302:       } finally {
303:         if (tests.get(id) === work) tests.delete(id);
304:       }
305:     },
306:     dataset: async (input) => {
307:       const id = RunId.parse(input);
308:       await deps.getRun(id);
309:       const dataset = deps.datasets.get(id);
310:       if (!dataset)
311:         throw new ReqflowError("not_found", "This run has no preserved research dataset.");
312:       return dataset;
313:     },
314:   };
315:   return {
316:     collector,
317:     handlers,
318:     invalidateSecret(name: import("@reqflow/core").SecretName) {
319:       // Planner keys are not provider adapter keys, but invalidate their active
320:       // requests too. Saved-key deletion may leave an environment fallback.
321:       revokeActive();
322:       for (const id of ResearchProviderId.options)
323:         if (PROVIDER_SECRETS[id].includes(name)) invalidate(id);
324:     },
325:     settingsChanged(previous: Settings, next: Settings) {
326:       if (
327:         JSON.stringify(previous.research) !== JSON.stringify(next.research) ||
328:         JSON.stringify(previous.llm) !== JSON.stringify(next.llm)
329:       )
330:         revokeActive();
331:     },
332:     async settle(runId: string) {
333:       await Promise.all([...(pending.get(runId) ?? [])]);
334:     },
335:     sanitize(run: WorkflowRun): WorkflowRun {
336:       const snapshot = structuredClone(run),
337:         keys = [...(safeValues.get(run.id) ?? [])];
338:       if (snapshot.error) snapshot.error = redactSecrets(snapshot.error, keys);
339:       for (const block of snapshot.blockRuns) {
340:         if (block.error) block.error = redactSecrets(block.error, keys);
341:         for (const log of block.logs) log.message = redactSecrets(log.message, keys);
342:       }
343:       return snapshot;
344:     },
345:     release(runId: string) {
346:       caches.delete(runId);
347:       cacheBytes.delete(runId);
348:       pending.delete(runId);
349:       safeValues.delete(runId);
350:     },
351:     async export(input: Parameters<ReqflowHandlers["exports"]["research"]>[0]) {
352:       const { runId, format } = z
353:         .strictObject({ runId: RunId, format: z.enum(["json", "xlsx", "csv"]) })
354:         .parse(input);
355:       const dataset = await handlers.dataset(runId);
356:       const path = await deps.chooseExport(format, runId);
357:       if (!path) return null;
358:       await writeFile(
359:         path,
360:         format === "xlsx"
361:           ? await exportResearchXlsx(dataset)
362:           : format === "csv"
363:             ? exportResearchCsv(dataset)
364:             : exportResearchJson(dataset),
365:         { mode: 0o600 },
366:       );
367:       await deps.audit.record({
368:         actor: actor(),
369:         action: "export.created",
370:         entityType: "export",
371:         entityId: runId,
372:         runId,
373:         rationale: `Raw research exported as ${format}; no analysis generated.`,
374:       });
375:       return { path };
376:     },
377:   };
378: }

### Re-Review Finding: Closed

The previously demonstrated active Research revocation vulnerability is verified **closed**. The implementation and test suite meet all specified contracts and constraints.

---

### Evidence & Verification Summary

#### 1. Controller Registration & Epoch Guard
- **Location:** `apps/desktop/src/main/research/runtime.ts` (lines 71–77, 124–134)
- **Mechanism:**
  - `const controller = new AbortController();` and `active.add(controller);` are executed synchronously in `collector(...).collect(...)` **before** asynchronous credential loading (`await credentials()`) begins.
  - `accessEpoch` is recorded before awaiting credentials (`const epoch = accessEpoch;`).
  - `revokeActive()` increments `accessEpoch++` and immediately invokes `controller.abort()` on all registered active controllers.
  - Post-credential guard (`if (epoch !== accessEpoch) controller.abort(...)`) followed by `signal.throwIfAborted()` prevents race conditions where an access change occurs while credentials are being loaded.

#### 2. Composed Caller & Permission Abort
- **Location:** `apps/desktop/src/main/research/runtime.ts` (lines 127, 199)
- **Mechanism:**
  - `const signal = AbortSignal.any([context.signal, controller.signal]);` composes the caller's cancellation signal with the runtime's revocation controller signal.
  - The composed signal is passed down into `createResearchCollector(...).collect(request, { ...context, signal })` and document reader operations.

#### 3. Active Lifetime Retained Across Collection
- **Location:** `apps/desktop/src/main/research/runtime.ts` (lines 126, 181–202)
- **Mechanism:**
  - `active.add(controller)` occurs before dispatching `work`.
  - `active.delete(controller)` runs in the `finally` block of `work` only after `await createResearchCollector(...).collect(...)` resolves or throws. The controller remains active and subject to `revokeActive()` across the entire duration of in-flight collection.

#### 4. Configure & Secret Invalidation (Including Planner Keys)
- **Location:** `apps/desktop/src/main/research/runtime.ts` (lines 216–222, 318–324) and `apps/desktop/src/main/handlers.ts` (lines 698–715)
- **Mechanism:**
  - `handlers.research.configure` calls `invalidate(id)`, which triggers `revokeActive()`.
  - `runtime.invalidateSecret(name)` unconditionally executes `revokeActive()` regardless of secret type, ensuring planner keys (e.g., `anthropic_api_key`, `openai_api_key`) as well as provider keys terminate active runs.
  - `handlers.settings.setSecret` invokes `research.invalidateSecret(name)` immediately after persisting the secret.

#### 5. Post-Persistence `settingsChanged` Wiring & Domain/Web-Off Revocation
- **Location:** `apps/desktop/src/main/handlers.ts` (lines 664–670) and `apps/desktop/src/main/research/runtime.ts` (lines 325–331)
- **Mechanism:**
  - In `settings.save`, settings are persisted first (`const saved = saveSettings(dataDir, validated);`), and `research.settingsChanged(oldSettings, saved);` is called immediately afterward.
  - `settingsChanged` compares `previous.research` vs `next.research` and `previous.llm` vs `next.llm`. Any change to `research.provider` (such as setting it to `"off"`), `allowedDomains`, `blockedDomains`, or API configs immediately triggers `revokeActive()`.

#### 6. Integration Test Coverage & Transport Non-Cooperation
- **Location:** `apps/desktop/src/main/research/integration.test.ts` (lines 461–536)
- **Verification:**
  - Tested all 5 parameter variations: `["disable", "remove-key", "web-off", "allowlist", "blocklist"]`.
  - Uses the real service and HTTP wrapper. A synthetic non-cooperative Firecrawl search hangs on a promise ignoring `AbortSignal`.
  - Cancellation settles to run status `"failed"` (`await wait(queued.id, "failed")`) before the late search response is released.
  - Earlier document dataset records (`bmw_sales`) survive untouched.
  - Following `/scrape` calls never dispatch (`expect(fetched.mock.calls.filter(...)).toHaveLength(0)`).
  - Later records from late responses are never ingested (`expect(dataset.records).toEqual(preserved)`).
  - Agent status for `owner_forums` is accurately marked `"cancelled"`.

#### 7. Apify Independent Cleanup & Preserved Cancellation
- **Location:** `packages/blocks/src/research/http.ts` (lines 282–322)
- **Mechanism:**
  - Apify cleanup uses bounded reservations (`APIFY_CLEANUP_REQUEST_LIMIT = 8`) and independent abort handling while preserving caller abort propagation (`withAbort`).

---

### Test Execution Results

- **Command:** `vitest apps/desktop/src/main/research/integration.test.ts`
- **Output:** 22/22 integration tests passing (0 failures), including all 5 active transport revocation cases:
  - `revokes active transport on disable, preserving earlier originals without a following scrape` (passed)
  - `revokes active transport on remove-key, preserving earlier originals without a following scrape` (passed)
  - `revokes active transport on web-off, preserving earlier originals without a following scrape` (passed)
  - `revokes active transport on allowlist, preserving earlier originals without a following scrape` (passed)
  - `revokes active transport on blocklist, preserving earlier originals without a following scrape` (passed)

No blockers remain. Re-review complete.
